name: Xylem's Payment to Jediga

narrative.details:
What is it? Oh yes, your payment. Of course.

Take this and be off with you. I'm sure Jediga is awaiting oh so patiently for your return.
narrative.objectives: Deliver Xylem's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
narrative.offerRewardText:
No problems? None at all? Well, that's something to be said... I expected him to show some sort of reluctance or to at least betray our deal. Hmm, maybe he can be trusted after all.

Well, no need to dwell on it that much. Here's your share. Thank you for your help.
narrative.requestItemsText: Well, what did Xylem have to say? He didn't do anything to you, did he? Cast a spell on you? Con you into doing work for him?

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 52, 11,450 XP in all.

quests.name: Stealing Knowledge
quests.objectiveText: Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.

quests.name: Delivery to Archmage Xylem
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Tablet of Sael'hai to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.

quests.name: Xylem's Payment to Jediga
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Xylem's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
